name: Additional Dwelling Unit Preapproval Applications - Historical

columns.name: ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for the record

columns.name: SUBMISSION_DATE
columns.description: Date when ADU preapplication was electronically submitted

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of ADU preapplication

columns.name: STATUS_UPDATED_DATE
columns.description: Date when ADU preapplication status was last updated

columns.name: APPLICANT_NAME
columns.description: Name of ADU preapproval applicant

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.description: Name of property owner (if different than  applicant)

columns.name: STREET_NUMBER
columns.description: Number portion of the property address

columns.name: STREET_DIRECTION
columns.description: Direction portion of the property address

columns.name: STREET_NAME
columns.description: Street name portion of the property address

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: Property address

columns.name: COMM_AREA
columns.description: The Community Area of the property

columns.name: WARD
columns.description: The Ward (City Council district) of the property

columns.name: ADU_ZONE
columns.description: The Additional Dwelling Unit-Allowed Area that the property is located in (See Section 17-7-0570 of the Zoning Ordinance)

columns.name: ZONING
columns.description: The zoning district of the property

columns.name: OWNER_OCC
columns.description: Whether the property is owner occupied

columns.name: ADU_TYPE
columns.description: The type of ADU

columns.name: EXISTING_BLDG
columns.description: Whether the preapproval is for an existing building on the lot

columns.name: YEAR_BUILT
columns.description: Year when the existing building on the lot (if any) was built

columns.name: CURRENT_DUS
columns.description: Number of legally-established dwelling units on lot

columns.name: MAX_ADUS
columns.description: Maximum number of ADUs allowed

columns.name: NEW_ADUS
columns.description: Proposed number of ADUs

columns.name: AFF_ADUS
columns.description: Minimum number of affordable ADUs

columns.name: PREV_ADUS
columns.description: Whether there is a previous ADU application at the address

columns.name: LATITUDE
columns.description: The latitude of the property

columns.name: LONGITUDE
columns.description: The longitude of the property

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the property in a format that allows for mapping and geographic analysis on this data portal.

columns.name: Boundaries - ZIP Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - ZIP Codes' (rpca-8um6) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Community Areas
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Community Areas' (vrxf-vc4k) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Zip Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Zip Codes' (6mkv-f3dw) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Census Tracts
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Census Tracts' (bdys-3d7i) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Wards
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Wards' (43wa-7qmu) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
